payload.message: TARGET_LOST: unqualified producer failure during station wait
execution slot released: TARGET_LOST: unqualified producer failure during station wait

payload.failure_reason: TARGET_LOST: station computation wait: untyped false object cannot preserve station

conclusions: The producer explicitly reported temporary missing support, with target_lost=false and support_measurement_available=false; it did not emit a station wait/recovery witness.
A false ObjectPose and empty mask followed this status. Both task and remote treated the untyped loss of geometry as terminal.
The very next actual measured source recovered READY/ObjectPose/mask approximately 0.268 seconds later, before the old 0.8-second geometry deadline.
The recovered READY no longer includes station_compute_wait because the actual task had already failed and ended its phase; this record must not be relabeled as a successful live station handoff.
limitations: These are exact recorded message contents and timestamps, not a reconstructed successful execution.
A new recovery implementation must bind a producer-issued typed witness to an already registered local parent; target_lost=false alone grants no authority.
Any test that restores active phase or maps clocks for replay must label that counterfactual explicitly.
No new mask or metric geometry is credited to the temporary unavailable frame.
